note: Coverage describes the editor, not game fidelity. Preview=APPROXIMATED means a Godot model consumes the value; it is not native verification.

entries.name: AllowHQShadows
entries.description: This value specifies if the object can cast a High quality Shadow. If set to false, only the Low (sprite) based shadow will render. Almost all classes support two Level Of Detail (LOD) models. LOD1 and LOD2 models are toggled when Object Detail setting in Graphics Options is set to Medium or Low, and based on either the user's Distance from the object, or the object's relative size on screen. Generally, LOD1 is used first at mid range, and LOD2 is used last at furthest range. LOD models do not support any Animations.

entries.name: dontShiftLOD
entries.description: This value, if set to true, will disable shifting of LOD values between LOD1 and LOD2, meaning the object will only use LOD1.

entries.name: geometryName
entries.description: This specifies the model name of the LOD1 entry. Model filename with extension, either XSI or FBX supported. Example: "ivtankL1.xsi"

entries.name: radius
entries.description: Radius threshold of screen size, determining how small the object must be on screen before considering switching to this LOD model.

entries.name: distance
entries.description: The distance from the object must be from the Player for it to consider using this LOD model.

entries.name: baseName
entries.description: baseName is used to override an object's base type identification. This is a quick way to set an object's F-Group unit Icon, Info key card, and Status display image name. By default, baseName will default to the file name of the ODF. For instance: ivmytank.odf will by default look for ivmytank.inf for it's Info card, icon_ivmytank.dds for it's unit icon, and wire_ivmytank.dds for it's status display image. Setting baseName = "ivtank" will make it try to use ivtank.inf, icon_ivtank.dds, and wire_ivtank.dds respectively. Though these can be overridden individually per ODF, this provides a quick and easy way to specify this object's base type.

entries.name: unitName
entries.description: This object's Name. This is what is displayed over the object's head, in the build menu, and Factory terminal panel. This string is also passed through the Translation table for localization.

entries.name: unitIcon
entries.description: This is the icon image that appears in the unit's F group. Default is the gCfg (baseName). _Note:_ This setting is not ODF Inherited.

entries.name: unitStatus
entries.description: This is the status image that appears above the weapons panel. Default is the gCfg (baseName). _Note:_ This setting is not ODF Inherited.

entries.name: infoName
entries.description: This is the Info key card that comes up when you press the Interact key while looking at an object. If not specified, it looks for the ODF name, with .inf extension. If that is not found, it looks for baseName with .inf extension.

entries.name: ignoreMissingInf
entries.description: If this is true, it will squelch the warnings about missing .inf files from this odf. _Note:_ This is not ODF Inherited.

entries.name: canInteract
entries.description: Determines if this object can be interacted with. Controls info card key interaction, point-space reticle interaction, being able to see health/ammo when looking at the object, etc. _Note:_ Default is false for: Boid, Terrain, Computer, CNozzle, KingofHill, ObjectSpawn, Person, Plant, Bush, Scrap.

entries.name: nation
entries.defaultRaw: race letter determined by the first character of the object's ODF name.
entries.description: This setting controls the default setting for if Factory/Constructor Chrome effect is used, and which type of Walker hierarchy is used. Both of these can be specified in their respective ODF Class sections, however. _Note:_ This setting is old, and only supports i and f.

entries.name: ownsTerrain
entries.description: If this object owns the terrain it is on. This registers this object's collision with the terrain cluster's collision map. _Note:_ Default is true for Buildings with terrain__h as their root mesh, or tunnelCount > 0.

entries.name: isTerrain
entries.description: Sets if this object is a terrain replacing object. If true, _Note:_ Default is true for Class: Terrain, Computer, CNozzle, and Buildings with terrain__h as the root model piece.

entries.name: needPilot
entries.description: If this object needs a pilot inside of it. _Note:_ Default is true for Craft. Only valid for Craft and Vehicle types. (Gun Towers are a Craft)

entries.name: playerOnly
entries.description: If this is true, only the Player can hop into this object.

entries.name: canDetect
entries.description: If true, this object can be seen on Radar. _Note:_ False for Class: Boid, Terrain, Computer, CNozzle, KingofHill, ObjectSpawn, Person, Plant, Bush,

entries.name: canSnipe
entries.description: If true, this object can be sniped. _Note:_ Defaults to true for Class: Craft, except for: AssaultTank, AssaultHover, SAV, Tracked, Turret, Walker.

entries.name: canCollide
entries.description: Controls if this object can be collided with. _Note:_ Defaults to true for Class: Craft, Flag, Mine, Powerup, Torpedo.

entries.name: boxCollide
entries.description: This changes the collision type to Box type, similar to Battlezone 1's vehicle collisions. It uses a rectangle box that uses the extents of each axis on the model to determine length,width, and height. _Note:_ Default is false for Class: Craft, Person, Powerup, Torpedo.

entries.name: isAssault
entries.description: This flags if this object should be considered for "Assault mode" when it is attacked. Certain AI Processes will use weapon hard points that are set as Assault, and morphtanks will Morph to Assault mode to attack objects with isAssault = true. _Note:_ Default is true for Class: Building, Tracked, Turret, Walker.

entries.name: isSingle
entries.description: If this is true, you can only Build one of this item on your team. _Note:_ Default is true for Class: Armory, Baracks, BomberBay, Bomber, CommTower, Factory, Recycler, RecyclerVehicle, RecyclerVehicleH, SupplyDepot.

entries.name: isGrouped
entries.description: If this is true, this object is placed in an F-Group slot. _Note:_ Default is true for Class: Craft, except for: Person, Turret.

entries.name: needGroup
entries.description: If this is true, this object needs a valid available F-Group to be able to Build it. _Note:_ Defaults true for Class: BomberBay, and Craft, except for: Person, Turret.

entries.name: isLimited
entries.description: If this object counts against the MP Unit Limit. _Note:_ Default is true for Class: Craft, except for: Person.

entries.name: needLimit
entries.description: If this object needs a free MP Unit Limit slot to Build it. _Note:_ Default is true for Class: Craft, except for: Person. limitClass1 ... limitClass32 = "" This is the provideName that this object limits against for the Team. limitClass1Count ... limitClass32Count = 0 This is how many of the corresponding limitClass# are allowed on the Team. limitClass1Text ... limitClass32Text = "" This is the Text displayed when you try to Build an item that has reached it's LimitCount. teamLimitClass1 ... teamLimitClass32 = "" This is the provideName that this object limits against for the entire Team Group. teamLimitClass1Count ... teamLimitClass32Count = 0 This is how many of the corresponding teamLimitClass# are allowed on the Team Group. teamLimitClass1Text ... teamLimitClass32Text = "" This is the Text displayed when you try to Build an item that has reached it's teamLimitCount.

entries.name: isStealth
entries.description: Determines if this object can be seen on Radar and Targeted with out line of sight.

entries.name: CanSelect
entries.description: If this object can be Selected via F-Slot or point-space Reticle interaction. _Note:_ Default is false for Class: CommBunker.

entries.name: NoShadow
entries.description: If this is true, the object doesn't cast a shadow.

entries.name: ClipDepth
entries.description: If false, this object doesn't perform depth clipping.

entries.name: Permanent
entries.description: If this is true, when the player who owns this object leaves an MP game, this object sticks around instead of exploding.

entries.name: AllowSeismic
entries.description: If this is false, this object is not moved by Class: Seismic.

entries.name: Tuggable
entries.description: If this object can be picked up by a Tug. Valid values are: -1 = default behavior, 0 = never tuggable, 1 = always tuggable _Note:_ Default is 0 for Class: Bomber, also Buildings, Tugs, and Turrets are never tuggable.

entries.name: ScanTeamLimit
entries.description: Determines which team(s) can see this object on Radar. Also prevents AI from targeting it if they can't see it. Valid values are: 0 = all teams, 1 = same team only, 2 = allies only, 3 = never visible on Radar. _Note:_ Default is 3 for Class: SpawnBuoy.

entries.name: PilotConfig
entries.description: If specified, this is the ODF of the pilot this unit starts with. Default is the race's *spilo.

entries.name: alwaysClip
entries.description: Determines if this object should always clip?

entries.name: SingletonGroup
entries.description: If true: GroupPanel (F Slots) can only select this group by itself, no others.

entries.name: IdenticalGroup
entries.description: If true: GroupPanel (F Slots) can only select this group with identical groups. _Note:_ Bomber class defaults to true.

entries.name: DAMAGE_SCALE
entries.description: This is a modifier of how much velocity is translated into damage upon collision. Calculation: _((Damage_Scale * massDifference * relativeVelocity) - 10) * armorRatio * shieldRatio_ armorRatio: N = 1.0, L = 0.75, H = 0.5 shieldRatio: N, A = 1.0, S = 0.75, D = 0.5.

entries.name: Mass
entries.description: This is the amount of mass an object has. If <= 0, it uses the default of Sphere(Width * Height * Breadth) * 800.0f. You can open an ascii-saved .sav or .bzn file with notepad to determine what existing objects have by default.

entries.name: allowTLI
entries.description: If true, allows Target Lead Indicator (TLI) on this object, assuming Server and Player preferences allow it.

entries.name: allowMDMCollisionDetonation
entries.description: This is a setting for if BounceBombs (MDM Mortar) explode upon contact with this object. Valid values are: -1 = auto (== hit non-building), 0 = never, 1 = always. [Applies to all bouncebombs.]

entries.name: enableServiceTruckPull
entries.description: Valid values are: -1 = auto, 0 = never, 1 = always pull this object when Service Truck serviced if moveable. Auto is classic behavior that this must be moveable & tuggable.

entries.name: serviceTruckAutoHeal
entries.description: This is a setting that controls if a Service Truck will automatically heal this object type. Valid values are: -1 = auto, 0 = never, 1 = always heal this. _Note:_ Setting this to 1 will cause Service Trucks to always heal this object, even if it does not meet their category requirements under [ServiceTruck]/[ServiceTruckH].

entries.name: Lifespan
entries.description: If this is >= 0, this is how many seconds, from creation, until the object is destroyed.

entries.name: CanAcceptPowerups
entries.description: If this is true, it can accept powerups. False if not.

entries.name: AcceptPowerupMask
entries.description: Bit Mask for what kind of Powerups this object can accept. Bitmask values:

entries.name: DeployedPowerupMask
entries.description: Bit Mask for what kind of Powerups can be accepted while Deployed. Refer to list above for values.

entries.name: PowerupRaceMask
entries.description: Bit Mask for which race's Powerups this object can accept. 27 total Bits, from a ... z, plus one for Powerups that don't start with a letter.

entries.name: DeployedPowerupRaceMask
entries.description: Bit Mask for which race's Powerups this object can accept while Deployed. See above for values.

entries.name: MaxChromeDistance
entries.description: If this is > 0, it will disable the Chrome effect of morphing/building when this object is that distance from the Camera.

entries.name: ExplosionEnergy
entries.description: How much Energy is passed into the Explosion. _Note:_ Only applies to Class: Building. Class Craft is read under [CraftClass].

entries.name: xplChunk
entries.description: Explosion Class ODF for when a Chunk hits the ground. Default is the race's *explosion.odf's value for xplChunk. _Note:_ Only applies to Class: Building. Class Craft is read under [CraftClass].

entries.name: xplCrash
entries.description: Explosion Class ODF for when the vehicle Crash model hits the ground. Default is the race's *explosion.odf's value for xplCrash. _Note:_ Only applies to Class: Building. Class Craft is read under [CraftClass].

entries.name: ExplodeSound
entries.description: The sound when this object Explodes. _Note:_ Only applies to Class: Building. Class Craft is read under [CraftClass].

entries.name: LeaveExplodeScorch
entries.description: If false, won't darken the ground when it explodes. _Note:_ Only applies to Class: Building. Class Craft is read under [CraftClass].

entries.name: LightsOnlyWhenPiloted
entries.description: If true, lights will be disabled when the craft has no Pilot, and toggle back on when a Pilot hops into it.

entries.name: AlwaysShowAmmo
entries.description: If true, it will display the Ammo bar under Health, even if the object is an Enemy.

entries.name: SmartIsAirUnitCheck
entries.description: If true, then it only considers Artillary, Bomber, APC, and SAV as "Flying". If false, it uses the isFlying flag which when the craft is greater than 2 * setAltitude from the ground.

entries.name: AllowFactoryCustomizations
entries.description: If false, this object can't be modified in the Factory Panel.

entries.name: StayWithOwner
entries.description: If this is true, objects that perform Construction in a TeamPlay game such as Class: Scavenger, ScavengerH, DeployBuilding, DeployBuildingH, ConstructionRig, will build the object on the same Team as the current owner, instead of it swapping to the Commander's Team.

entries.name: AllowUndergroundSpawn
entries.description: If this is false, objects with models that extend below terrain will be forced up if they are spawned via Script. If true, will spawn with the model's root position at terrain height. Default is true for Class: Building.

entries.name: UseCollisionMeshForPathing
entries.description: If this is 0, it won't use collisionMesh for pathing, if it is 1, it will use the CollisionMesh for pathing. Default is -1, which is true for isTerrain objects.

entries.name: FactoryCustomizationMask
entries.description: Bit Mask for which Weapon Slots are editable in the Factory Panel. Valid values are:

entries.name: PowerupSlotAcceptMask
entries.description: Bit Mask for which Weapon Slots can accept Powerups. Valid values are:

entries.name: AlignTerrainReplaceType
entries.description: Controls how the object snaps to terrain squares. Valid values are 0 - 5. Some experimentation required.

entries.name: DeployOnBuild
entries.description: Setting for if this object sets a Deploy state upon initial creation. 0 is force Undeploy. 1 is force Deploy. _Note:_ Bombers and APCs ignore this setting.

entries.name: VehicleSearchFilter
entries.description: Filter for what types of targets this object attacks. Valid values are:

entries.name: TerrainBlendRadius
entries.description: Setting for how many vertices around the boarder of a Building get blended to it's height. Larger values means smoother blending. Default is 3 for Class: Building.

entries.name: MaxPostExplosionVelocity
entries.description: Maximum velocity able to be added to an object from an Explosion. Default is 250% velocForward for Class: Tracked, and 50.0m/s for everything else. This is used with DamageIfVelocityClamped to calculate Damage from excess Velocity.

entries.name: DamageIfVelocityClamped
entries.description: Amount of health lost if Velocity is clamped by maxPostExplosionVelocity.

entries.name: GameObjectClassServiceMask
entries.description: Bit Mask for use with [SupplyDepotClass]::SupplyDepotClassServiceProvides to allow service.

entries.name: GameObjectClassServiceMatch
entries.description: Bit Mask for use with GameObjectClassServiceMask and [SupplyDepotClass]::SupplyDepotClassServiceProvides to allow service.

entries.name: GameObjectClassServiceProvides
entries.description: Bit Mask for what use with [SupplyDepotClass]::SupplyDepotClassServiceMask and [SupplyDepotClass]::SupplyDepotClassServiceMatch to allow service.

entries.name: GameObjectClassPowerUpMask
entries.description: Bit Mask for use with [PowerupClass]::PowerupClassProvides to allow pickup.

entries.name: GameObjectClassPowerUpMatch
entries.description: Bit Mask for use with PowerupClassMask and [PowerupClass]::PowerupClassProvides to allow pickup.

entries.name: GameObjectClassPowerUpProvides
entries.description: Bit Mask for what use with [PowerupClass]::PowerupClassMask and [PowerupClass]::PowerupClassMatch to allow pickup.

entries.name: maxHealth
entries.description: This object's maximum Health. 0 is indestructible.

entries.name: addHealth
entries.description: How much health this object gains over a 1 second time period.

entries.name: aiAddHealth
entries.description: How much health this object gains over a 1 second time period, when piloted by an AI, not a User. CondAddHealthMinRatio1 ... CondAddHealthMinRatio8 = -1 Conditional AddHealth minimum Health Ratio that this object must be for the conditional to pass. CondAddHealthMaxRatio1 ... CondAddHealthMaxRatio8 = -1 Conditional AddHealth maximum Health Ratio that this object must be for the conditional to pass. CondAddHealthValue1 ... CondAddHealthValue8 = 0 Amount of AddHealth done by this conditional. CondAddHealthFlags1 ... CondAddHealthFlags8 = 2147483647 Bit Mask for which Flags are used to enable this AddHealth. Values listed below:

entries.name: DoBettyHealth
entries.description: If true, does the Betty "Low Health" warning when the user's Health is below 25%.

entries.name: maxAmmo
entries.description: This object's maximum Ammo. 0 is NOT infinite.

entries.name: addAmmo
entries.description: How much ammo this object gains over a 1 second time period.

entries.name: aiAddAmmo
entries.description: How much ammo this object gains over a 1 second time period, when piloted by an AI, not a User.

entries.name: DoBettyAmmo
entries.description: If true, does the Betty "Low Ammo" warnings when the user's Ammo (or available shots in the currently selected Weapon) reaches 0.

entries.name: aiName
entries.description: AI Process name. This is the brains of the unit, and controls it's behavior. aiName is used for Player controlled craft, or if no aiName2 is specified. This must be one of the specified AI Process strings, and must be a valid type for the Class of object. Valid AI Names are listed in the AI Processes section. _Note:_ Specifying an incorrect AI Name will lead to crashes.

entries.name: aiName2
entries.description: AI Process name for Non-Player controlled objects, if specified. This must be one of the specified AI Process strings, and must be a valid type for the Class of object. Valid AI Names are listed in the AI Processes section. _Note:_ Specifying an incorrect AI Name will lead to crashes.

entries.name: collisionRadius
entries.description: This is the object's collisionRadius size, used for AI avoidance and path planning.

entries.name: CanBeIdleVictim
entries.description: If true, then this object can be the target of an AIP Plan's idle units dispatch.

entries.name: DoBettyAttack
entries.description: If true, will do the radar beep and warning Betty sounds when this object is damaged. ** Weapon Settings ** weaponHard1 .... weaponHard5 = "" This is the hard point name in the Model. The name must start with one of the following, and it must match exactly with a piece in the model. These traditionally have "HP_" in front of them, to make them Hidden Parts, but that isn't required. The following are valid Hardpoint names, with or without HP_ in front of them:

entries.name: weaponMask
entries.description: Binary bit mask for which weapons, out of the 5 weapon hard points, that the AI should try to use. 0 = don't use, 1 = use. _Note:_ The order goes from right to left, for hard point 1 - 5. So effectively "54321".

entries.name: imageSignature
entries.description: This is the object's Image signature strength. It controls how fast Image Launchers can lock onto it.

entries.name: radarSignature
entries.description: This is the object's Radar signature strength. It controls how fast Radar and Torpedo Launchers can lock onto it.

entries.name: heatSignature
entries.description: This is the object's Heat signature strength. It controls how fast Thermal Launchers can lock onto it, and how strongly Thermal Missiles are attracted to it.

entries.name: armorClass
entries.description: This object's Armor type. Valid values are:

entries.name: shieldClass
entries.description: This object's Shield type. Valid values are:

entries.name: hitType
entries.description: What kind of explosion is used when an ordnance hits this object. Valid values are:

entries.name: explosionName
entries.description: If specified, this is the explosion ODF to use. For iexample: explosionName = "xbldxpl". Default if not specified is chosen from the race's explosion.odf based on this object's type. damageEffect1 ... damageEffect4 = "dmgvhcl1" ... "dmgvhcl4" These are the Renders for the Damage Smoke. Below is a list of when they are used:

entries.name: scrapCost
entries.description: This is the amount of scrap this object costs to build, when built from a Recycler, Factory, Armory, or Constructor.

entries.name: scrapValue
entries.description: This is the amount of scrap the object drops when destroyed.

entries.name: scrapReturn
entries.description: This is the amount of scrap the object returns when it is Recycled, or it's construction is Cancelled.

entries.name: powerCost
entries.description: This is the amount of Power the the object consumes while it exists.

entries.name: buildTime
entries.description: This is the amount of time, in seconds, it takes to build this object.

entries.name: customCost
entries.description: This is the amount of scrap the object cost to build, if it's weapons have been modified through the user interface terminal in a Recycler/Factory.

entries.name: customTime
entries.description: This is the amount of time, in seconds, it takes to build this object, if it's weapons have been modified through the user interface terminal in a Recycler/Factory.

entries.name: CanDropScrap
entries.description: If false, this object doesn't drop scrap when it dies. _Note:_ Default is false for Class: Person ScrapClass1 ... ScrapClass3 = "" This is the ODF name of the scrap pieces dropped by this object. If not specified, it defaults to the race's *pscr1 ... *pscr3, respectively.

entries.name: buildRequire
entries.description: This specifies the requirement for building adjacency. It must be built on Terrain that matches this type. Valid values are:

entries.name: buildSupport
entries.description: This specifies what kind of building adjacency this object supports nearby. Valid values are:

entries.name: ClearBuildZone
entries.description: This setting controls if this object is pushed out of a building's build zone while it's under construction. For example: If you order a Constructor to build a building on top of a Turret, the turret gets pushed out of the building area. Valid values are: -1 = auto, 0 = never, 1 = always. If 0/1, overrides collide-able setting.

entries.name: CategoryTypeOverride
entries.description: This is the object's Category Type. Default is based on the type of object it is. Setting this to >= 0 overrides that. Valid values are:

entries.name: requireCount
entries.description: The number of requireName# entries it uses. Max is 16. requireName1 ... requireName16 = "" This is a valid odf or provideName that this object requires to exist on the same team before it can be Built. requireText1 ... requireText16 = "" This is the Text that is displayed when you try to Build an item missing the corresponding requireName entry.

entries.name: provideCount
entries.description: The number of entries this object Provides for Requirements. Max is 32. _Note:_ If this is <=0, the object still provides it's ODF name. provideName1 ... provideName32 This is the Name that this object provides for Requirements.

entries.name: upgradeName
entries.description: The ODF name that this object can be Upgraded to, if specified.

entries.name: FactoryWeaponConfig
entries.description: This is a setting for what weapon.odf list is used for this unit when modifying it in a Factory Panel. If not specified, the default is the race's weapon.odf list. _Note:[i/] Must end in .odf, e.g. "iweapon.odf"[/list]_

entries.name: geometryScale
entries.description: This model's Scale. _Note:_ Skinned meshes do not scale well.

entries.name: mrmFactor
entries.description: Depreciated, old method of LOD for Skinned meshes.

entries.name: animCount
entries.description: Number of Animations to load for this object. animName1 ... animName# = "" Name for Animation. Some classes play animations on their own. See list of supported AnimNames for each Class. animFile1 ... animFile# = "" Model file name for the specified Animation. Can be .XSI or .FBX _Note:_ You can use .XSI files with a .FBX geometryName, as long as the hierarchy matches.

entries.description: Model file name for the Cockpit model. Can be .XSI or .FBX

entries.description: Scale for Cockpit Model.

entries.description: Number of Animations to load for Cockpit model. animNameCockpit1 ... animNameCockpit# = "" Name for Animation. See list of supported AnimNames for each Class. animFileCockpit1 ... animFileCockpit# = "" Model file name for the specified Animation. Can be .XSI or .FBX _Note:_ You can use .XSI files with a .FBX cockpitName, as long as the hierarchy matches.

entries.name: collisionName
entries.description: If specified, this is used as the collision model. _Note:_ This overrides default collision, or any __c meshes in the geometryName mesh.

entries.description: Scale for collisionName mesh. lightHard1 ... lightHard8 = "" This is the model hard point name for the Light. Must be a valid model piece name, no other name restrictions. Typically "HP_Light_#". lightName1 ... lightName8 This is the ODF name for the corresponding light. effectHard1 ... effectHard16 = "" Model hard point for this Effect. Max of 10 for each type. _Note:_ Only applies to Class: Building. Class Craft is read under [CraftClass]. entries.name: crashName
entries.description: Model file name for the Crash model. _Note:_ Only applies to Class: Building. Class Craft is read under [CraftClass].

entries.name: crashScale
entries.description: Scale of the crashName model. _Note:_ Only applies to Class: Building. Class Craft is read under [CraftClass].

entries.name: hasSeparateChunks
entries.description: If this is true, it reads SeparateChunkEffect# for separate chunk models. Aim12CannonError3 = 0.75, 0.5, 0.2, 0.0 Only used if Use13Aim is false. How much to subtract from the Cannon GetLeadPosition leading time when aiming. AttackTaskAttackTimeout0 ... entries.description: If false, doesn't create a Sprite of "lightflare.tga" and "lighthalo.tga" at it's origin.

entries.name: rotationRate
entries.description: Rotation rate of the Render.

entries.name: spriteCenter.x
entries.description: Offsets the Center position of the Sprite texture on the X Axis. 1.0 is 100%.

entries.name: spriteCenter.y
entries.description: Offsets the Center position of the Sprite texture on the Y Axis. 1.0 is 100%.

entries.name: innerRadius
entries.description: Inner radius of sphere.

entries.name: outerRadius
entries.description: Outer radius of sphere.

entries.name: staticTime
entries.description: Overrides the lifeTime value, if present.

entries.name: segmentTime
entries.description: Overrides the animateTime value, if present.

entries.name: tracerLength
entries.description: Length of the Tracer geometry.

entries.name: BottomInteractsWithTerrain
entries.description: If true, squishes vertically to avoid clipping through Terrain.

entries.name: emitLife
entries.description: Time in seconds that each emitted TwirlRender lasts.

entries.name: maxDist
entries.description: Distance from Camera for it to stop Rendering.

entries.name: maxRadii
entries.description: Radius outside of Camera view for it to skip Rendering.

entries.name: groupDelay

entries.name: waveAngle
entries.description: Angle of the Wave. Pi is fully circular.

entries.name: waveDepth

entries.name: waveColorCenter
entries.description: Color of the wave in the Center.

entries.name: waveColorEdge
entries.description: Color of the Wave at the Edge.
